# Desks

The Lark desk is 120 cm wide, 60 cm deep, and 74 cm high. It has a powder-coated steel frame and a laminated birch worktop. The cable opening is 60 mm in diameter. Maximum evenly distributed load is 50 kg.

# Care

Clean with a slightly damp microfiber cloth. Abrasive cleaners can dull the laminate. The optional Lark drawer unit fits beneath either side of the desk and requires 42 cm of clear width.
